name: GNDEC + GND Polytechnic campus
disclaimer: Walking times are estimates along mapped campus paths. Building outlines use OpenStreetMap footprints. Room-to-block links are inferred from official room codes (F/S/G/A) and can be corrected in Admin; indoor room positions are not surveyed.

places.name: Main Gate (Gill Road)
places.description: The Gill Road entrance used by most day scholars. Buses and autos drop off just outside.

places.name: North Gate (hostels)
places.description: Service entrance on the hostel side of campus.

places.name: West Gate (staff colony)
places.description: Entrance near the staff colony and Director's bungalow.

places.name: South Gate (polytechnic)
places.description: Shared entrance towards the polytechnic side of the campus.

places.name: Administration Block
places.description: Principal's office, college office and the main reception. The portico with the college name is the usual meeting point.

places.name: Admission Cell
places.description: Admission and document verification desk, inside the Administration Block.

places.name: Central Library
places.description: Central library and reading room. Reference section and journals are on the upper floor.

places.name: G-Block (G1–G18)
places.description: Classroom block next to the Administration Block. Most G-series rooms are on the ground floor.

places.name: F-Block (F101–F119)
places.description: First-floor classrooms used mostly by first-year sections.

places.name: S-Block (S201–S221)
places.description: Second-floor classrooms and seminar rooms near the Applied Science building.

places.name: Applied Science Block
places.description: Physics, chemistry, English and measurement laboratories, plus the Applied Science department office.

places.name: Information Technology Department
places.description: IT department offices and labs (OS, PL, WD, HPC, DBMS). North side of the academic area.

places.name: Computer Science & Engineering
places.description: CSE department and programming labs. Position is approximate — follow the CSE signage from the north academic area.

places.name: Electronics & Communication
places.description: ECE department, electronics labs and the computer lab for EC.

places.name: Mechanical Engineering
places.description: Mechanical department, CGL and material testing labs, next to the workshops.

places.name: Civil Engineering
places.description: Civil department, geotech and survey labs.

places.name: Electrical Engineering
places.description: Electrical department and BEE / PE laboratories.

places.name: Central Workshops
places.description: Manufacturing practice, welding, carpentry and machine shops. Wear closed shoes for practicals.

places.name: Automobile Block
places.description: Automobile engineering workshops and A6/A9 rooms.

places.name: College Auditorium
places.description: Indoor auditorium used for orientations, guest lectures and cultural events.

places.name: Open Air Theatre
places.description: Outdoor stage and seating used for fests and cultural nights.

places.name: Sports Complex
places.description: Indoor sports hall, gym and sports office.

places.name: Swimming Pool
places.description: Campus swimming pool, east side near the canal.

places.name: Football Ground
places.description: Main football field, next to the Open Air Theatre.

places.name: Hockey Ground
places.description: Hockey field on the north-west side of campus.

places.name: Basketball Court
places.description: Outdoor basketball courts near the hostels.

places.name: Boys Hostel
places.description: Boys hostel and mess area on the north side of campus.

places.name: Girls Hostel
places.description: Girls hostel (Hostel No. 4) at the north-west corner.

places.name: Hostel No. 5
places.description: Hostel and mess building on the east side.

places.name: Mess No. 1
places.description: Main hostel mess.

places.name: Day Scholar Canteen
places.description: Canteen near the academic area — tea, snacks and quick meals.

places.name: College Dispensary
places.description: First-aid and basic medical help on campus.

places.name: Punjab & Sind Bank
places.description: Bank branch and ATM inside campus.

places.name: Business Administration (MBA)
places.description: MBA department, computer lab and seminar hall BA. Position is approximate.

places.name: Maintenance Cell
places.description: Campus maintenance and works office.

places.name: CDRT
places.description: CDRT centre and workshops.

places.name: Testing & Consultancy Cell
places.description: Testing and consultancy services, near the library.

places.name: Director's Bungalow
places.description: Director's residence on the north-west side.

places.name: GND Polytechnic
places.description: Guru Nanak Dev Polytechnic, on the shared campus south of GNDEC.

places.name: Diploma Building
places.description: Polytechnic diploma classrooms and labs.

places.name: Diploma Canteen
places.description: Canteen shared with the polytechnic side.

places.name: GNDP Hockey Ground
places.description: Polytechnic hockey ground and stadium area.

edges.note: Walk west from the gate along the boundary road.
Follow the road past the swimming pool turn.
Cut across the central lawn towards the academic blocks.
Pass the automobile block and workshops.
Continue south past the Mechanical department.
Walk west along the classroom row.
Library is the next building west.
Continue west towards the bank and staff colony.
Exit towards the staff colony.
Head north along the east boundary.
Follow the road to the hostel circle.
North gate is behind the hostels.
Walk north past the football ground.
Head south past the Applied Science block.
Cross towards the polytechnic side.
Polytechnic main block is ahead.
Exit at the shared south gate.
MBA block is just south of the library.
Short link back to the west walk.
Direct path between the central quad and lab crossing.
Pass the Open Air Theatre on your left.
Cut through the classroom row.
